newsitem.title: INDIA: India bank disbursals up in early October -- RBI.
newsitem.headline: India bank disbursals up in early October -- RBI.

text.p: Indian commercial banks showed a rise in credit disbursals early in October, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Monday.
Bank credit (excluding inter-bank advances) of all banks amounted to 2,738.58 billion rupees on October 11, up from 2,711.33 billion rupees on September 27, RBI said in a release.
Bank credit had amounted to 2,403.33 billion rupees a year ago, on October 13, 1995, RBI said.
Liabilities to the banking system, including demand and time deposits, amounted to 160.61 billion rupees, down from 160.86 billion on September 27, 1996, RBI said.
Banks' liabilities to others including deposits (other than from banks) rose to 4,831.35 billion rupees on October 11, up from 4,819.91 billion on September 27.
Borrowings from the RBI fell to 10.23 billion rupees on October 11 from 18.40 billion rupees on September 27.
